nodes.title: Adversarial review 'who gets called' (dial gate, consent, DPDP, minors): 9 confirmed defects (2 blocker, 5 major, 2 minor), each with a test that fails on bd7d8dd; 11 suspected classes could not be reproduced and were discarded.
nodes.source: independent reviewer session (main loop's review phase)
nodes.method: Reviewer read campaigns/gate.ts, worker, intake and memory/minor.ts. Each claim became a todo test through the real runGate or tool bodies on a throwaway Postgres 16; tests in product/tests/review/who-gets-called.test.ts, details in .md (c937ebf).
nodes.value: 2 blocker / 5 major / 2 minor; discarded: double dial, review-stop overshoot, hold leak, mid-call opt-out, merge, number formats, Devanagari digits, salt, retry vs G7, future dials, test ring, tenancy

nodes.title: G5 treated any NCPR status outside the registered list as 'not registered', so 'unknown' passed promotional dials.
nodes.source: review WGC-01 (blocker), confirmed by reading gate.ts
nodes.broke: In production the DND provider is disabled and contact.dnd_refresh stamps checked_at with status 'unknown'. Every consented promotional row became dialable, including DND-registered numbers. Rule: an allow list ('not_registered' only), never a block list, for any fact that permits a call.

nodes.title: G5 took the latest consent record per purpose and accepted any granted covering purpose, so an older 'all' grant outranked a newer 'promotional' or 'service' withdrawal.
nodes.source: review WGC-03 (blocker), confirmed by reading gate.ts; WGC-06 adds that order was insert time, not consent time
nodes.broke: A person who withdrew from promotional calls was still called promotionally because an older 'all' grant counted as a basis. Re-importing an old consent=yes file also became the latest record. Rule: the newest record by effective time across every purpose covering the call's category decides; withdrawals win ties.

events.details: campaigns: WGC-01..05, 07, 08 (gate). intake: WGC-06 (consent effective time), WGC-09 (birth_year and age_group keys), and erasure cancelling queued attempts. memory: read birth_year and age_group, failing closed. tests/review/ now runs in CI (failing todos report without failing the run).
